cards.ex: That band was a total one-hit wonder; I haven't heard anything from them since.
cards.exUz: Bu guruh faqat bir hit qo'shiq bilan mashhur bo'ldi; ulardan keyin hech narsa eshitmadim.
cards.uzDef: Faqat birgina mashhur qo'shig'i bilan tanilgan ijrochi yoki guruh.

cards.ex: She can really belt out a song; her voice is amazing.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham qo'shiqni baland kuylay oladi; uning ovozi ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shiqni baland va kuchli ovoz bilan kuylamoq.

cards.ex: His musicality is evident in every note he plays.
cards.exUz: Uning musiqiyligi har bir notada yaqqol ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Musiqaga sezgirlik va uni tushunish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: You must have a good ear for music to pick that out.
cards.exUz: Buni ajratib olish uchun sizda yaxshi musiqa qobiliyati bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Musiqani yaxshi eshitish va farqlash qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I attended a master class with a famous violinist last week.
cards.exUz: O'tgan hafta taniqli skripkachi bilan mahorat darsida qatnashdim.
cards.uzDef: Tajribali mutaxassis tomonidan beriladigan o'quv darsi.

cards.ex: She has incredible stage presence; she commands the audience's attention.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib sahna mahoratiga ega; u tomoshabinlarning e'tiborini tortadi.
cards.uzDef: Sahna ustida o'zini tutish va auditoriyani jalb qila olish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Their album went platinum within a month of its release.
cards.exUz: Ularning albomi bir oy ichida platina bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Albomning juda ko'p nusxasi sotilganini anglatadi.

cards.ex: Nothing beats the energy of a live performance.
cards.exUz: Jonli ijroning energiyasiga hech narsa teng kelmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Tomoshabinlar oldida to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ijro etish.

cards.ex: Some bands sell out to get more commercial success.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi guruhlar ko'proq tijorat muvaffaqiyatiga erishish uchun sotiladilar.
cards.uzDef: O'z ijodiy tamoyillaridan voz kechib, pul uchun ishlamoq.

cards.ex: The musical landscape has changed dramatically in the last decade.
cards.exUz: Musiqiy muhit so'nggi o'n yillikda keskin o'zgardi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud musiqiy uslublar va tendentsiyalar to'plami.

cards.ex: Their new single is expected to hit the charts next week.
cards.exUz: Ularning yangi singli kelasi hafta chartga kirishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shiq yoki albomning eng yaxshi musiqiy reytingga kirishi.

cards.ex: She's a seasoned performer, so she doesn't get nervous on stage.
cards.exUz: U tajribali ijrochi, shuning uchun u sahnada asabiylashmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yillik tajribaga ega bo'lgan ijrochi.

cards.ex: He was just playing to the gallery with those outrageous comments.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki o'sha shafqatsiz izohlar bilan ommani xursand qilmoqchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Auditoriyani xursand qilish uchun harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: They performed an a cappella version of the song.
cards.exUz: Ular qo'shiqning a cappella versiyasini ijro etishdi.
cards.uzDef: Musiqiy asboblar jo'rligisiz faqat ovoz bilan ijro etish.

cards.ex: I'm completely tone-deaf, so I can't sing.
cards.exUz: Men butunlay qo'shiqni noto'g'ri aytaman, shuning uchun kuylay olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Musiqiy tovushlarni to'g'ri eshita olmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: If she doesn't get her act together, she'll lose the part.
cards.exUz: Agar u o'zini qo'lga olmasa, u rolni yo'qotadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zingni yaxshi tutishni boshlash, tartibga kelish.

cards.ex: A lot of hard work goes on behind the scenes to produce a show.
cards.exUz: Ko'rsatuvni tayyorlash uchun sahna ortida ko'p mehnat qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaga ko'rinmaydigan, yashirin holda.

cards.ex: The understudy was waiting in the wings, ready to go on.
cards.exUz: Dublyor sahnaga chiqishga tayyor bo'lib, qanotlarda kutib turardi.
cards.uzDef: Sahna qanotlarida, chiqishga tayyor bo'lib turish.

cards.ex: The concert went off without a hitch, thankfully.
cards.exUz: Konsert, xursandchilik bilan, muammosiz o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday muammosiz, yaxshi o'tmoq.

cards.ex: She has a real musical flair; she can play almost anything.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy musiqa iste'dodiga ega; u deyarli hamma narsani ijro eta oladi.
cards.uzDef: Musiqaga nisbatan tabiiy qobiliyat va uslub.

cards.ex: He was just going through the motions in his performance; he didn't seem interested.
cards.exUz: U shunchaki o'z chiqishida bajarib qo'yayotgandi; u qiziqish bildirayotgani yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir ishni xohishsiz, shunchaki bajarish uchun qilmoq.

cards.ex: The speaker had a captive audience because the storm trapped everyone inside.
cards.exUz: Ma'ruzachi asirga olingan tomoshabinlarga ega edi, chunki bo'ron hammalarni ichkarida qamab qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Eshitishga majbur bo'lgan tomoshabinlar.

cards.ex: She can really hit the high notes; it's amazing.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham yuqori notalarni ola oladi; bu ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Qo'shiqda yuqori notalarni yaxshi ijro etish.

cards.ex: The piano was out of tune, so it sounded terrible.
cards.exUz: Pianino sozlanmagan edi, shuning uchun dahshatli eshitildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri notalarni chalish yoki kuylash.

cards.ex: Every musician has to pay their dues before they become famous.
cards.exUz: Har bir musiqachi mashhur bo'lishidan oldin o'z haqini to'lashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun qiyinchiliklarni boshdan kechirmoq.

cards.ex: After such a brilliant performance, he's a hard act to follow.
cards.exUz: Bunday ajoyib chiqishdan keyin, u qiyin vazifa.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi muvaffaqiyatli narsadan keyin muvaffaqiyatga erishish qiyin.

cards.ex: Her song is currently on the charts and rising fast.
cards.exUz: Uning qo'shig'i hozirda chartlarda va tez ko'tarilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Musiqiy hit paradlarda o'rin egallamoq.

cards.ex: The introduction set the stage for an exciting performance.
cards.exUz: Kirish qismi hayajonli chiqish uchun sahna yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Keyingi voqealar uchun sharoit yaratmoq.

cards.ex: Even though the lead actor was sick, the show must go on.
cards.exUz: Bosh aktyor kasal bo'lishiga qaramay, ko'rsatuv davom etishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsaga qaramay tadbir davom etishi kerak.

cards.ex: She tried to upstage me by wearing a more elaborate costume.
cards.exUz: U yanada murakkab kostyum kiyib, mening e'tiborimni tortib olishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamdan ko'ra ko'proq e'tiborni o'zingga tortmoq.
